scripts/check-contribution-derivation.mjs deriveContributions() at ourRetailCad 94.99, itemCostCad 55.24 (LIST, rule 22), supplierShipCad 0, dutyRate 0.07 - the 'wholesale' basis, the only Canadian basis.
costSource: AliExpress Canadian-gateway per-SKU price from window._d_c_ PRICE.skuPriceInfoMap on listing 1005006439147774, SKU 200000795:10#D;249:200006305#No light bulb, read 2026-09-14: salePriceString C$51.70 against originalPrice C$55.24. That is a 6% gap - a promotion, not rounding - so RULE 22 makes the LIST price the cost basis and itemCostCad is 55.24, NOT 51.70. Not yet cross-checked against a DSers stable cost: the product does not exist in Shopify or DSers yet, and the DSers reading is the mapping step, not the sourcing step. Read keyed by skuIdStr: this listing's SKU ids are adjacent (...587/588/589) and String(skuId) collapses them to one float, which is how the first pass read all three shades at C$43.96. The lattice is the dear shade on the listing: C$11 over the cage and the teardrop.
dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price.
verdict: Priced at CA$94.99, CA$9.62 over the CA$85.375 amazon.ca wall-sconce band median and CA$3.19 under the CA$98.18 RULE 2 ceiling. Contributes CA$20.07/unit on the wholesale basis (7% MFN on value for duty) at the LIST cost of C$55.24 with free freight, against the CA$16.23 floor - clears by CA$3.84. It cannot take the cage and teardrop's CA$89.99: at that price the list cost files 15.74, CA$0.49 under the floor, so it takes the next x.99 up, still inside the band. Rule 22: the page sells at C$51.70, a 6% gap under the C$55.24 originalPrice, so the LIST price is the cost basis and the sale price is upside the model does not count. Per-SKU stock 200 clears rule 4 (>= 25). straight lines where every other fixture in the range is round - a square lattice box is not the cone, the cage (B) or the teardrop (C), and nothing in the pendant range is square. VOLTAGE: the spec table's Voltage field reads 220 V; the fixture is a bare E26 socket and cord with PCBA N, which is the case the 220 V hold was lifted for on 2026-09-14, and this seller's own gallery sheet prints 110-120 V, so the copy states 110-120 V from the seller's sheet.
supplierSkuNote: 'D' is the seller's lampshade-colour swatch letter and describes nothing about the product - the shade is a 15 x 25 cm square shoji-style lattice of bamboo sticks over white panels, open at the top and bottom. Recorded so a human can find the row in DSers.
supplierSkuUnitCapMethod: Read as skuStock from window._d_c_ lifeCycleEventList[0].data.SKU.skuPaths[] on listing 1005006439147774, joined per-variant to PRICE.skuPriceInfoMap. Per-SKU, not the listing total. Not clamp-tested via the quantity box; skuStock is the same field every other Canadian offer's cap was read from.
retailNote: Priced 2026-09-14 at CA$94.99, the only one of the three arm sconces not at the cone's CA$89.99: its C$55.24 list cost files 15.74 there, under the 16.23 floor. CA$94.99 is the lowest x.99 that clears (20.07) and sits CA$3.19 under the 98.18 ceiling. If the list price rises by more than about C$3.60 this comes off; re-read cost before any paid push.
